statutory_framework.section_47: Section 47, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (Assignment of new registration mark on removal to another State exceeding 12 months)
statutory_framework.section_48: Section 48, Motor Vehicles Act, 1988 (No Objection Certificate in Form 28; deemed approval after 30 days under Sec 48(3))
statutory_framework.tax_refund_statute: State Motor Vehicles Taxation Acts (Pro-rata lifetime tax refund upon re-registration in new state)

required_documents: Form 28 in triplicate with pencil chassis imprint
Proof of address in destination state
NOC / Crime clearance certificate from State Traffic Police
Receipt of road tax paid in destination state (for refund claim)
